description: Visit plain tab-delimited file rows in encounter order with one-based line positions and preserved field bytes.

interface.semantic_input: Caller-supplied path to a local plain tab-delimited byte file.
interface.semantic_output: A synchronous file reader that visits ragged field vectors with one-based line positions.

resources: Retains the path and processes one line and its fields at a time. Maximum line length, memory use and throughput are unmeasured.

preconditions.detail: Supply a valid path string and a synchronous visitor. The successful fixture domain is local regular files. Each callback borrows fields only for that visit.

postconditions.detail: Newline separated the tested physical records. Tabs split each row, preserving blank, ragged, repeated and trailing empty fields, with one-based positions.

refinements.detail: The reader stripped one terminal CR, kept interior CR and whitespace, treated quote bytes literally and preserved embedded NUL, multibyte text and an invalid UTF-8 byte in the recorded direct fixtures.

effects.detail: Open and directory read failures occurred on visit with no rows delivered. Both ordinary file programs left existing destinations unchanged or absent as appropriate on the tested reader failures.

invariants.detail: Repeating each visit returned the same rows and restarted positions at one on the frozen files.

mathematical_properties.detail: No general proof of the line, field or byte-preservation laws was established.

formal_predicates.detail: The scope is the tested local byte-file behavior.

state_protocol.detail: Construction did not read the missing path. A visitor exception escaped with the tested message, and a subsequent visit restarted at the first row.

ownership.detail: The producer could read after the original path storage had been changed and destroyed. The visitor copies any fields it retains.

concurrency.detail: Concurrent visits and concurrent modification of the input were untested.

upstream_usage.detail: The retained project test reads empty and final unterminated record fields through the same TSV header.

specification_question.detail: Is the input plain tab-delimited text where every tab separates a field?
